runtime_note: The Space source revision was observed at execution time. Its model downloads are not revision-pinned; the exact loaded base/adapter weight hashes were not exposed. These are not local ComfyUI results.
billing: Free public ZeroGPU quota only; no paid credentials, credits, subscription or purchase used.
postprocessing: None by this repository. Originals are the provider-returned WebP bytes, not raw model tensors or guaranteed lossless files.
browser_provenance_note: The embedded Space UI exposes a returned file URL and asset/cache identifier, not a generation/job event ID. Browser runs record these separately without inventing an event ID. Their actual PNG input is preserved as well as the original WebP source hash. Chrome decoded and PNG-encoded the 1024-square source for clipboard transport, with no resize, crop or retouch. Decoder rounding differs slightly from Pillow's WebP decoding (maximum channel difference 2/255), so the two inputs are not claimed to be pixel-identical.
